label: Log collection task
type: a cluster-wide, at-most-one-at-a-time asynchronous job that gathers Couchbase Server log files from one or more nodes, optionally redacting and/or uploading them for support. Started/monitored/stopped via couchbase-cli collect-logs-start/-status/-stop.
hasExecutionConstraint: only one log collection task may run at a time in the cluster
evidence: This command collects all Couchbase Server log files from one or more nodes in the cluster.
Note that only one log collection task may be running at any given time in the cluster.
The upload flag is intended for Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition users who need to upload logs to the Couchbase Support Team to aid in diagnosis.
note: The upload capability requiresEdition edition:enterprise; the task itself is not edition-gated.
relates_to_competency_question: Can two administrators collect logs from the same cluster at the same time, and how would a script check?
